results.reason: Learn identifies 2026-06-01 as latest stable GA. Exact FleetMemberProperties requires clusterResourceId, which is an ARM ID restricted to managedClusters; the source receives the AKS resource ID. group constraints are minLength 1, maxLength 50 and the exact regex; main.bicep passes base-cluster, which satisfies them.
results.migration: Current 2026-06-01 is latest GA; no GA migration needed.

current.analysis: Learn selector and pinned Fleet stable OpenAPI identify 2026-06-01. Schemas helper expanded FleetMemberProperties and confirmed required clusterResourceId (string/arm-id limited to managedClusters) and group (string min/max/pattern). Exact caller values are AKS ID output and base-cluster; the latter passes the pattern.

ga.analysis: Learn lists 2026-06-01 as the latest stable GA and 2026-06-02-preview as a newer preview. Exact candidate schema is the same pinned stable fleets.json; preview is not treated as GA.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log: 2026-06-01 adds FleetMemberProperties.meshProperties; it is optional and unused. Required clusterResourceId and group constraints remain in the exact current schema.
